evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own; he finds that interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed (conversation flow in the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; Calvin's response in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T7].
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked "what made you start working on cars?") that his car passion started when he was ten: he'd been fascinated with how machines work, found an old car in a neighbor's garage, and asked if he could fix it — "that's when my love for car engineering began!" — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; comes with his remark that working on a car is his outlet — "a little oasis of calm" — where he's "connecting back with myself" — see the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; complements the childhood memories of tinkering with engines in his dad's garage recorded above; Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life.", and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is working on another project — Dave answered in the continuation of the same day's chat, which is not in this excerpt: he restored a car last year (2022, the 2022 restoration, see above) but sold it to a collector, and is now working on a new car project he finds quite a challenge [S25T14][S25T15][S25T16][S25T17].
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked what the toughest part of car restoration is) that it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off — echoing his earlier remarks that small details make his mod project unique and personalized (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) and that the small successes make him proud (see above) [S25T18][S25T19].
- On 2023-10-25, said working on a car project "takes me out of my head and calms me down" — complementing his long-stated "oasis of calm"/therapy remarks above [S26T4].
- As of 2023-10-29, is also getting into photography (a new hobby — details and the Boston photos he shared are in the Photography section below) [S27T2][S27T8].
